name: Claude Opus 4.5
description: Anthropic's frontier reasoning model. Best fit when a task requires chaining several judgment calls together, not just a single classification or lookup.

name: GPT-4o mini
strengths: cheapest per-call cost in the catalog
description: A small, fast OpenAI model tuned for high-volume classification and routing decisions where cost per call matters more than depth of reasoning.

name: Gemini 2.0 Flash
strengths: reads scanned PDFs and architecture exports
description: Google's multimodal model, used for reading architecture diagrams, scanned documents, and image-heavy inputs.

name: text-embedding-3-large
strengths: strong retrieval recall for enterprise documents
weaknesses: not a generation model — always paired with a second model for RAG
description: OpenAI's embedding model for retrieval-augmented patterns. Rarely the primary model in a recommendation, but frequently a supporting one.

name: Llama Guard 3
strengths: broadest compliance coverage in the catalog
weaknesses: not intended as a primary generation model
description: Meta's open-weight moderation and policy-compliance classifier, typically self-hosted and recommended as a supporting model alongside a primary generation model in regulated use cases.
